purpose: measure source-origin critical-fact retention, localized recovery and refusal on previously unopened public filings
authority: SEC EDGAR primary Inline XBRL filing HTML
filing_selection: for each fixed CIK, choose the most recent non-amended 10-Q filed on or before the cutoff; if unavailable, record the issuer unresolved and do not replace it
existing_data_exclusion: exclude a filing when its accession or primary-document SHA-256 already occurs in a repository benchmark or research manifest; do not replace it

fact_eligibility.element: visible ix:nonfraction inside a table cell
fact_eligibility.visible_text: must contain at least one digit
fact_eligibility.geometry: finite visible bounding box at least 4 by 4 CSS pixels
fact_eligibility.semantic_binding: record name, contextRef, unitRef, decimals, scale, sign and normalized visible value
fact_eligibility.duplicate_rule: the exact tuple name/contextRef/unitRef/normalized visible value must be unique in the filing

fact_selection: SHA256(CIK + accession + name + contextRef + unitRef + normalized visible value) ascending; take the first four eligible facts per filing

render.browser: one installed Playwright Chromium revision recorded in the acquisition receipt
render.target: nearest table row containing the selected fact

input_contract: each crop binds filing URL, accession, filing HTML SHA-256, DOM fact identity, row bbox, fact bbox, PNG SHA-256 and source fact hash
router_policy: run MinerU and Paddle in parallel; if their normalized critical-token multisets agree, accept the lower historical-cost candidate; otherwise run Ovis and accept only a candidate corroborated by another model on the complete critical-token multiset; otherwise unresolved

scoring.primary_endpoint: silent critical fact loss rate over selected SEC facts
secondary: route regret against best fixed and diagnostic Oracle

runpod.stop_rule: stop and terminate all new pods on spend ceiling, identity mismatch, denominator drift, repeated runtime failure or completed fixed call budget
runpod.cleanup: terminate every created pod and record a zero-live-pod receipt
